chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shamoun, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Yunus ibn Abi al-Aswad, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, Allah created the hearts of the believers wrapped up over faith. So when He intends to enlighten what is in them, He opens them with wisdom and plants them with knowledge, and its Planter and the One in charge of it is the Lord of the Worlds.
ai.seo_question: How does Allah enlighten the hearts of believers according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In the context of al-Kulayni’s *al-Kafi*, this hadith elucidates the divine origin of spiritual insight, portraying the believer's heart as inherently veiled until Allah actively illuminates it with *hikmah* (wisdom) and *ilm* (knowledge). It underscores the Shia theological emphasis on Allah as the ultimate *Zari'* (Planter) and *Qayyum* (Sustainer) of the heart, highlighting that true faith is a divine gift rather than merely a human achievement. This concept aligns with the broader tradition of *tazkiyah* (purification), where divine grace works in tandem with human receptivity to reveal inner truths.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman, from Abdullah Bin Al Qasim, from Yunus Bin Zabyan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allahazwj Created the ‘قُلُوبَ’ (Qalub – plural of Qalb) of the Momineen wrapped up over the Emān. So whenever he (the Momin) intends to enlighten what is in it, begins it with the wisdom and cultivates it with the knowledge, and its Cultivator and the Overseer upon it is the Lordazwj of the Worlds’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Shammun from ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Qasim from Yunus ibn Zabyan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Allah has created the hearts of the believers wrapped up over belief. When He wills to light it up He opens it with wisdom and plants it with knowledge. The farmer and guardian thereof is the Lord of the worlds.”
